South Surrey presale projects on my list

Three projects on my list sit in the South Surrey area, going by the locations the sources give: Calais at Semiahmoo Town Centre, Rockford at 128 Street and 17 Avenue in Ocean Park, and Harlowe at 16485 18 Avenue, described by its sources as Sunnyside Heights and Grandview Heights. All three are scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2028.

Form as the developer states it: 86 homes — 25 townhomes + 61 condominiums — in a 6-storey woodframe building, the condominiums on the top three floors and the townhomes wrapping the parkade. Its sales gallery is open by appointment only, as is usual for a presale. Harlowe is not a 55+ project.
Calais — by Polygon Homes — 15265 16 Avenue, Semiahmoo Town Centre

Form as stated in presale-directory sources (secondary): a 20-storey mixed-use highrise with a 6-storey podium, 180 condominiums from studios to 3-bedroom suites, described as South Surrey's first tower. Calais is not a 55+ project.
Rockford — by Cressey Development — 128 Street and 17 Avenue, Ocean Park (listing address 1655 128 Street)

Rockford is a 4-storey concrete low-rise of 1- to 3-bedroom homes, which the developer describes as the only new build in the heart of Ocean Park. Cressey expects completion in spring 2027; the disclosure statement has the official date. It is not a 55+ building.

Condos and townhomes listed and sold in September 2026, by sub-area: Grandview 146 listed, 20 sold (14%); King George Corridor 131 and 27 (21%); Pacific Douglas 25 and 4 (16%); White Rock 193 and 20 (10%); Sunnyside Park 28 and 9 (32%), the highest rate in South Surrey and White Rock. blocks.text: Your rights when you buy a presale

items.t: Under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act, you can cancel a presale purchase within 7 days of signing the agreement or receiving the disclosure statement, whichever is later, and your deposit must be held in trust. The disclosure statement, not the listing or the presentation centre, sets the completion date, the deposits and exactly what you're buying, so have a lawyer read it within those 7 days.

The regulator: in British Columbia, real estate trading services are regulated by the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA), and BCFSA states a licensed professional must only work for either the buyer or the seller in a transaction and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party.

Plans and zoning depend on the city. Buildings in Surrey fall under the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 21900, adopted June 15, 2026, replacing Bylaw 18020) and Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. Buildings in White Rock, such as Foster Martin, fall under White Rock's own Zoning Bylaw No. 2506 (2024) and Official Community Plan No. 2220 (2017). In Surrey, small-scale multi-unit housing rules (July 8, 2024) allow up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², 4 on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, and a secondary suite can be no more than 40% of the main home's floor area.

A presale competes with every resale, not just other presales. In September 2026, 593 condos and townhomes were for sale across South Surrey and White Rock, with a combined median of $700,000, selling at 99% of list price in 33 days. A presale bought today will compete with that market when it completes.

The page's completed-communities list is the tell. The same page that sells "new construction & presales" expressly lists eleven finished townhome communities as "finished complexes, not presales" — Fox and Aikins North, South Village, Hyde Park, Greenway, Arista, Jacobsen, The Heights, SOHO, Blu Living, Brownstones at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners. Read every card against that admission before assuming a listing is a presale.

blocks.text: New lots and land in South Surrey

items.t: Explicitly not 55+.

Calais (Polygon Homes, 15265 16 Avenue, Semiahmoo Town Centre, winter 2027 wording) and Rockford (Cressey Development, 128 Street and 17 Avenue, Ocean Park, spring 2027 wording): Both explicitly not 55+. Not land for sale. (Presale list above.)
Fee-simple lots / bare-land strata: A bare-land strata lot, where one exists elsewhere, is strata tenure (Form B, fees, bylaws apply to the lot).
Every named project above sells built-form homes, not lots.

The new-construction search mixes true presales with nearly-new resales: a recent resale condo, resale units in sold-out towers, move-in-ready half duplexes and townhomes. Check whether a listing is a presale or a resale before you compare prices.

Condos and townhomes listed and sold in September 2026: Grandview 146 listed, 20 sold (14%); King George Corridor 131 and 27 (21%); Pacific Douglas 25 and 4 (16%); White Rock 193 and 20 (10%) (SnapStats, September 2026).

Presale rules: deposits are usually 10% to 20% in total, paid in stages during construction. Check the current rules on BCFSA's site, and have a lawyer read the disclosure statement within your 7-day right to cancel.
The specific warranty for a project is in its disclosure statement.
City plans in Surrey: the current Official Community Plan is Surrey 2050 (Bylaw No. 21900, adopted June 15, 2026), which replaced Bylaw 18020. Zoning is set by Zoning Bylaw No. 12000.

If a property is in the Agricultural Land Reserve (none of these projects is): subdividing needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR homes can't be stratified. The main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is only allowed inside it, and one additional home can be up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or 186 m² on larger parcels. Farm tax status has three income tiers: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha, and $10,000 under 0.8 ha, with applications due by October 31.

BC strata rules (these new homes are strata, and the same rules apply to bare-land strata lots): the Form B must be provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page. Since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, and since November 1, 2023 at least 10% of the operating budget must go into the contingency reserve. Rental restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022, and the only valid age bylaw is 55 and older (with exemptions from May 1, 2023), so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.

Property transfer tax: 1% on the first $200,000, 2% up to $2 million and 3% above that, plus another 2% on the residential part over $3 million. Examples: $500,000 → $8,000; $700,000 → $12,000; $800,000 → $14,000 ($6,000 for a first-time buyer who fully qualifies); $900,000 → $16,000; $1 million → $18,000; $1.2 million → $22,000; $1.5 million → $28,000; $1.8 million → $34,000; $2 million → $38,000; $3.5 million → $93,000. The newly built home exemption is full up to $1,100,000 and partial up to $1,150,000. It applies to new homes, not bare land.
GST on new housing / vacant land: new housing is generally GST-taxable (the presale case); for vacant land itself, CRA GI-003 level only.

Regulator: BCFSA regulates BC real estate trading services; a licensed professional works for either buyer or seller only and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party. Registering with your own agent before a first presentation-centre visit matters for representation (page copy).

Sunnyside Park had the fastest condo and townhome sales in the area in September 2026 (32%: 9 sold of 28 for sale), ahead of Morgan Creek (23%) and the King George Corridor (21%). That shows where resale competition is tightest; it isn't a presale figure.

faq.a: The developer must give you a disclosure statement before you sign, and you can cancel in writing within 7 days of the later of signing and receiving it. Deposits are held in trust. Have a lawyer read the disclosure statement within those 7 days.
faq.q: What protection does a BC presale buyer have?

faq.a: No. "Estimated completion is early 2028" is the developer's estimate in listing text; the disclosure statement's date range and amendment history are the only project documents that govern. Never treat a card's completion wording as a date you can plan a move on.
faq.q: Can I plan a move on a card's completion wording?

faq.a: GST: yes, 5% on a developer sale, subject to the First-Time Home Buyers' GST/HST Rebate (100% of GST to $1M, maximum $50,000, phasing to $1.5M, agreements on/after March 20, 2025) and the older GST New Housing Rebate. PTT: the general tiers apply, subject to the Newly Built Home Exemption (full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000) for a qualifying new principal residence. A resale — even a nearly-new one like the King & Crescent card — carries no GST.
